    # Cloud masking function for Landsat 8 (keep clear and water pixels)
    def mask_l8_sr(image):

    def mask_s2_clouds(image):
        scl = image.select('SCL')
        # Keep only pixels classified as water (SCL = 6)
        mask = scl.eq(6)
        return image.updateMask(mask)

    # Create median composites
    image_2015 = col_2015.map(mask_l8_sr).median().clip(lake_bosumtwi)
    image_2023 = col_2023.map(mask_s2_clouds).median().clip(lake_bosumtwi)

    # Define common reducer arguments
    reduce_args = {
        'reducer': ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        'geometry': lake_bosumtwi,
        'scale': 30, # Use native resolution
        'maxPixels': 1e9
    }
